title: Brooklyn search autocomplete shows United States (not USA)
userJourney: Locate the search bar on the homepage
Click or focus the location/search input field
Wait for the autocomplete/dropdown suggestions to appear
Verify that Brooklyn's suggestion shows 'United States' as the country (not 'USA')
expectedResult: The autocomplete dropdown for 'Brooklyn' shows the country as 'United States', not 'USA'
